_comment: MAGIC v2 (design doc v3). Every spell has a 'level' 1-5; its COST IS COMPUTED by the engine (level x 2 + 1 = 3/5/7/9/11 SP) so a cost can never desync from a level — do not add a 'cost' field. WHO can cast: 'classes' (ids from classes.json), gated by character level (spell level 1 at char levels 1-3, 2 at 4-7, 3 at 8-11, 4 at 12-15, 5 at 16-20). Fields: stat = ability whose modifier boosts the spell (int = arcane, wis = divine); type = damage | heal | buff | afflict; range/area in battle squares (area 1 = a 3x3 burst, area 2 = 5x5). Damage spells never miss: each target rolls a save (d20 + bonus vs DC 10 + spell level + caster's stat mod) — 'save' names the resisting ability; success = half damage. auto = true means no save at all. Buffs last the battle: 'hit' adds to attack rolls, 'dmg' to damage; targets = self | allies. 'condition': {id, rounds} lands on targets that FAIL their save. type 'afflict' = no damage, just the condition (save or suffer). 'rare': true = scroll-only lore — nobody learns it from training; only a Wizard-lane spellbook can copy it in from a scroll (items.json 'scroll' items name a spell id). DAMAGE GUIDELINE (doc): ~2d6 per spell level. All spells below level 1 are new CONTENT-FLAG drafts — rename, retune, add, and cut freely! VISUALS: optional "fx" per spell — {"kind": bolt (a dart travels caster→target) | beam (a straight ray connects them) | lightning (a jagged crack) | burst (no travel — the blast just blooms at the target, washing every square it caught) | sparkle | wisp, "color": any hex, "burst": fire | frost | holy (adds that blast sprite at impact — bolts and beams may carry one)}. Spells without fx get sensible defaults by type. Sprites live in assets/fx/ (regenerate via the art manifest).

frost_lance.name: Frost Lance

paralyze.name: Paralyze

witchfire.name: Witchfire

fireball.name: Fireball

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt

ice_storm.name: Ice Storm
ice_storm.description: Hail like fists — a battering burst of frost

arcane_ruin.name: Arcane Ruin
arcane_ruin.description: Unmaking, aimed — one target's very substance rebels

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.description: A piece of the night sky, called down — scroll-lore, found not taught

meteor_swarm.name: Meteor Swarm
meteor_swarm.description: Burning stones from a torn sky, across a great burst

disintegrate.name: Disintegrate

cure_light_wounds.name: Cure Light Wounds

bless.name: Bless

cure_serious_wounds.name: Cure Serious Wounds
cure_serious_wounds.description: Closes wounds that would scar a lesser blessing

searing_ray.name: Searing Ray
searing_ray.description: Focused daylight, hot enough to judge

pillar_of_light.name: Pillar of Light

cure_critical_wounds.name: Cure Critical Wounds
cure_critical_wounds.description: Calls an ally back from death's doorstep

wrath_of_heaven.name: Wrath of Heaven
wrath_of_heaven.description: The sky opens. It is not pleased

great_restoration.name: Great Restoration
great_restoration.description: Near-total renewal for one ally — flesh remembers its best day

holy_word.description: A syllable of the first language. Few remain standing to hear its echo

wicked_weapon.description: The blade hungers (+1 hit, +2 damage this battle)
